surface: organic generative discovery adjacent to paid media
mechanism: Generative shopping surfaces may alter discovery paths, but sponsored placement mechanics and incremental ad effects must be measured separately.

sources.claim_boundary: Confirms Rufus use, not ad attribution, paid placement weights, or incremental sales.

testable_hypotheses.change: Track generative-discovery observations separately from sponsored search exposure.
testable_hypotheses.metric: channel-separated qualified traffic, conversion and incrementality estimate
testable_hypotheses.success: measurement identifies a stable, decision-relevant difference
testable_hypotheses.guardrail: no attribution relabeling or budget change without causal evidence
testable_hypotheses.stop: identity, exposure, or attribution quality gate fails

invalidation_conditions: Amazon publishes a unified paid-organic measurement contract
